title: Corrigendum to: Zero divisor graph of a lattice with respect to an ideal
claim_quote: p. 1, Abstract: "In this paper, we point out several errors in [M.Afkhami, K.Khashyarmanesh and K.Nafar, Zero divisor graph of a lattice with respect to an ideal, Beitr Algebra Geom 56 (2015), 217-225.]." "In the previous article, Afkhami claimed that the intersection of all prime ideals belonging to an ideal I of a distributive lattice L equals to I. In this corrigendum, a counterexample for this sentence is constructed." p. 2: "In fact case (4) is impossible to happen. In this corrigendum theorem 3.4 is presented with a reformed proof." p. 3, §2: "Afkhami mistakenly define that a prime ideal P of L is called a prime ideal belonging to an ideal I if I ⊆P. In fact, a prime ideal P of L is called a prime ideal belonging to an ideal I if P ⊆I." "the previous proposition is not true" (Proposition 2.1 of the corrected paper).
corrected_paper: Zero divisor graph of a lattice with respect to an ideal
rationale: correcció significativa / fora d'abast de patches (producte): el corrigendum dona un contraexemple que refuta una proposició, corregeix la definició de ideals primers, reforma la prova del Theorem 3.4 i corregeix altres proves/resultats; no és una errada localitzada apta per a un patch petit. El paper d'Afkhami, Khashyarmanesh i Nafar no és cap dels documents del repo.
